hooks.command: sh -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$root" && exec uv run python "$root/.codex/hooks/pre_publish_gate.py"'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Set-Location -LiteralPath $root; uv run python (Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/pre_publish_gate.py')"
